content.short: Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol on Ethereum providing USDe, a stable, crypto-native solution for global DeFi.
content.description: Ethena is a pioneering synthetic dollar protocol on Ethereum that introduces USDe, a crypto-native and stable financial instrument. Unlike fiat-backed stablecoins, USDe maintains its peg through delta-neutral hedging of staked Ethereum collateral. This creates the 'Internet Bond,' a globally accessible yield-bearing instrument independent of traditional banking. The protocol addresses the need for a decentralized and censorship-resistant stable asset in Web3. By leveraging Ethereum staking and derivatives markets, Ethena offers a robust solution for capital preservation and yield.
